subject: Arrival and a small favor
text: Hi, I heard you're settling in next week and wanted to help with the timing. If you plan to arrive after noon, the service entrance is easiest because the main street is being repaved. The cart is parked near it, so we won't block the path. We can meet by the brown mailbox around the corner. One small favor: could you bring the short extension cord from the hallway shelf? I need it for the lamp in the waiting area. The rest of the visit should be simple; I'll show you the break room and the recycling bins. If you need directions from the bus stop, text me before you leave.
